textos.1 dose de dTpa em toda gestação a partir: 1 dose of Tdap in every pregnancy from 20 weeks, regardless of the interval since the last dose. If not vaccinated during pregnancy, vaccinate in the postpartum period as soon as possible, up to 45 days after delivery (PNI).
textos.Preencha só os que tiver. Colesterol tot: Fill in only the ones you have. Total cholesterol, HDL and creatinine allow PREVENT to be calculated; HbA1c and the albumin/creatinine ratio refine it. With creatinine, we calculate the eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021); with chronic kidney disease checked and the albumin/creatinine ratio, also the risk of kidney failure (KFRE).
textos.A SBC 2025 inclui o ácido úrico nos exam: SBC 2025 includes uric acid in the routine tests for hypertension; AHA/ACC treats it as an optional test, without serial repetition. We suggest one measurement at the initial evaluation.
textos.ACIP e SBIm concordam no esquema de 3 do: ACIP and SBIm agree on the 3-dose schedule (0, 1-2 and 6 months) and on the first booster 1 year later. They differ on later boosters: every 2-3 years per ACIP and every 3 years per SBIm. We show both intervals.
textos.Acima de 70 anos, só sugerimos rastrear: Above 70 years, we only suggest screening with BMI ≥ 25 and a risk factor (USPSTF 2021: screening from 35 to 70 years). ADA 2026 has no stopping age: consider it if life expectancy justifies.
textos.Até 30 anos, nós optamos por seguir a re: Up to 30 years, we chose to follow the PCDT-IST 2022 reference (annual test). USPSTF 2019 asks for at least one test from 15 to 65 years and repetition only with increased risk.
textos.Colonoscopia a cada 10 anos (45-75 anos): Colonoscopy every 10 years (45-75 years). Alternative: annual fecal immunochemical test (FIT). We suggest choosing one of the two methods with the patient and removing the other.
textos.Com PA de 130-139/80-89 mmHg, nós optamo: With BP of 130-139/80-89 mmHg, we chose to follow the AHA/ACC 2025 reference (stage 1 hypertension, to be confirmed with HBPM or ABPM). SBC 2025 calls this range prehypertension and only considers hypertension from 140/90 mmHg.
textos.Mulher pós-menopausa com menos de 65 ano: Postmenopausal woman under 65 years with a fracture risk factor: calculate FRAX (Brazil) and order densitometry if the risk is elevated. We suggest confirming that the patient is postmenopausal.
textos.No tipo 1, a uACR e a TFG anuais começam: In type 1, annual uACR and eGFR start 5 years after diagnosis (in type 2, from diagnosis). We have no way to know the duration of diabetes: the uACR can be removed if the diagnosis is less than 5 years old and there is no other indication.
textos.Não sugerimos densitometria ao homem sem: We do not suggest densitometry for men without a risk factor (USPSTF 2025: insufficient evidence). BHOF 2022 recommends it from 70 years, and from 50 to 69 with a risk factor: shared decision.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da A: We chose to follow the ACOG and Williams reference (repeat at 28 weeks and give anti-D immunoglobulin); the Ministry of Health (CAB 32) repeats the indirect Coombs every 4 weeks from 24 weeks.
We chose to follow the ADA 2026 reference (screening from 35 years, whatever the weight). USPSTF 2021 restricts screening from 35 to 70 years to people with overweight or obesity.

We chose to follow the AHA/ACC 2025 reference: echocardiogram only with an indication (ECG with left ventricular hypertrophy, suspected heart failure, hard-to-control hypertension). SBC 2025 includes the echocardiogram in the evaluation of cardiac target-organ damage.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da F: We chose to follow the FEBRASGO 2023 and Conitec 2026 reference (100-150 mg at night, until 36 weeks); USPSTF 2021 and ACOG use 81 mg/day, started at 12 to 28 weeks and continued until delivery.

We chose to follow the FEBRASGO/SBEM 2022 reference (TSH for all at the start of prenatal care); ATA 2017 and ACOG screen selectively (thyroid disease, type 1 or other autoimmune diabetes, positive anti-TPO, age > 30, BMI ≥ 40, previous miscarriage or preterm birth, neck irradiation, amiodarone or lithium).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da S: We chose to follow the SBIm reference (from 18 years in chronic cardiopulmonary disease and moderate or severe immunodeficiency; routine from 70 years). ACIP recommends the vaccine from 75 years and, from 50 to 74, only with increased risk.

We chose to follow the SBIm and PNI reference: from 28 weeks, with no upper limit, 1 dose in each pregnancy. ACIP and ACOG recommend 32 to 36 weeks, during the season, and do not repeat the dose in a later pregnancy.

We chose to follow the SBIm and CRIE reference, which do not list smoking as a risk, and did not include PCV20. ACIP recommends PCV20 from 19 to 49 years in cigarette smokers (and in alcohol use disorder).
We chose to follow the SBIm reference: 2 doses 2 months apart in unvaccinated adults with asplenia or HIV. ACIP recommends a single dose in asplenia and does not recommend Hib in adults with HIV.

We chose to follow the SBIm reference: 2 doses at least 1 month apart. ACIP recommends MenB-4C (Bexsero®) from 16 to 23 years by shared decision, in 2 doses at 0 and 6 months, and outside this range only with increased risk.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da U: We chose to follow the USPSTF 2021 reference (all sexually active women up to 24 years, annually); the Ministry of Health 2025 technical note restricts the test in the SUS to vulnerable populations.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da b: We chose to follow the US label reference for neutrophils (weekly up to 6 months, every 2 weeks up to 12 months and monthly after); the Brazilian label asks for weekly up to 18 weeks and monthly after. Myocarditis: troponin and CRP before starting and on days 7, 14, 21 and 28; troponin above 2 times the limit or CRP above 100 mg/L indicate stopping.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do C: We chose to follow the CDC 2023 and Ministry of Health reference (panel once in adults without documented vaccination). USPSTF 2020 recommends screening only people with increased risk (B).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do P: We chose to follow the Ministry of Health PCDT reference for all tenofovir (creatinine and urinalysis every 3-6 months). HIVMA/IDSA accepts longer intervals with tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), less nephrotoxic than the fumarate (TDF).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do U: We chose to follow the USPSTF 2018 reference: PSA by shared decision from 55 to 69 years and no screening from 70. MS/INCA (Technical Note 9/2023) does not recommend population screening: only shared decision with those who ask for the test. SBU, SBOC and SBRT propose individual discussion from 50 years with life expectancy above 10 years, and from 40 to 50 years with family history, Black ethnicity or a BRCA mutation.

We chose to follow the USPSTF 2021 and USMSTF 2022 reference: screening from 45 years, with colonoscopy every 10 years or annual FIT (the physician chooses one of the two). MS/INCA (2026) adopted FIT as the SUS test for asymptomatic people from 50 to 75 years, with colonoscopy if positive, and does not screen before 50.

We chose to follow the USPSTF 2024 reference: biennial mammography from 40 to 74 years. CBR/SBM/FEBRASGO 2023: annual from 40 to 74. Ministry of Health (Technical Note 626/2025): biennial screening from 50 to 74; from 40 to 49, on demand, after a conversation about risks and benefits.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do W: We chose to follow the Williams reference (chlamydia for all at the 1st visit); USPSTF 2021 screens pregnant women from 25 years only with increased risk (new or multiple partners, partner with an STI, previous STI).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com câncer colorretal: First-degree relative with colorectal cancer before 60 years (or 2 or more relatives): colonoscopy every 5 years, starting at 40 years or 10 years before the age at diagnosis of the youngest relative (whichever comes first). With the relative's age entered in the family history, we calculate the start.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B com o painel: Hepatitis B screening with the triple panel, once, in adults without a documented complete vaccine series (3 doses). Reactive anti-HBs without HBsAg and anti-HBc: immune, no vaccine needed. Whole panel non-reactive: susceptible, vaccinate. Reactive HBsAg or anti-HBc: investigate infection. Repeat if there is a risk factor (USPSTF 2020). Hepatitis B screening at the initial evaluation. Reactive HBsAg: HBV viral load. We suggest vaccinating non-immune people; with reactive anti-HBs there is no need to repeat. Repeat serology before switching to a regimen without tenofovir.
textos.Sem HAS, não sugerimos ECG ao diabético: Without hypertension, we do not suggest an ECG for asymptomatic people with diabetes (ADA 2026: do not screen for coronary disease in asymptomatic people). ACCF/AHA 2010 considers a baseline ECG reasonable (IIa): order it if the physician chooses to.
textos.Sugerimos a 25(OH)D basal no uso de cort: We suggest baseline 25(OH)D with corticosteroid use for 3 months or more (Sparling 2024). ACR 2022 recommends optimizing calcium and vitamin D without requiring the measurement, and the Endocrine Society 2024 suggests not measuring routinely in adults without an indication. If the choice is empirical supplementation, the test can be removed.
textos.Sugerimos a relação aldosterona/renina n: We suggest the aldosterone/renin ratio in resistant hypertension (AHA/ACC 2025, class 1, with any potassium) and in hypertension with sleep apnea (Endocrine Society 2016). We also suggest screening with spontaneous or diuretic-induced hypokalemia, adrenal incidentaloma, persistent BP ≥ 150/100 or family history of hypertension or stroke before 40 years. The Endocrine Society 2025 suggests screening all people with hypertension (conditional recommendation, low certainty).
textos.Sugerimos confirmar a tipagem ABO/Rh da: We suggest confirming the ABO/Rh typing from the 1st visit. If Rh negative: indirect Coombs at 28 weeks and anti-D immunoglobulin at 28 weeks and up to 72 h after delivery (Rh-positive newborn).
textos.Sugerimos rastrear (teste molecular) se: We suggest screening (molecular test) if there is increased risk: new or multiple partners, partner with an STI, previous STI, exchanging sex for money or drugs.
textos.Sugerimos rastrear e tratar hipertensão,: We suggest screening for and treating hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, obesity and kidney disease, common in gout, and avoiding diuretics to treat hypertension when there is an alternative.
textos.Triagem de hepatite B na avaliação inici: Hepatitis B screening at the initial evaluation. Reactive HBsAg: HBV viral load. We suggest vaccinating non-immune people; with reactive anti-HBs there is no need to repeat. Repeat serology before switching to a regimen without tenofovir.
textos.TFG < 60 sem doença renal crônica marcad: eGFR < 60 without chronic kidney disease checked: an isolated result does not confirm the disease. We suggest repeating creatinine and uACR in 3 months. With CKD confirmed and checked on the form, we show the stage and the risk of kidney failure.
textos.O risco de falência renal (KFRE) foi val: The kidney failure risk (KFRE) was validated in CKD G3 to G5 (eGFR < 60).
textos.Com a relação albumina/creatinina urinár: With the urine albumin/creatinine ratio (uACR) entered, we calculate the risk of kidney failure (KFRE) and complete the staging (A category).
textos.Risco em 2 anos acima de 40%: pela KDIGO: 2-year risk above 40%: per KDIGO 2024 (PP 2.2.3), it is time to discuss kidney replacement therapy modalities, plan vascular access and evaluate for transplant.
textos.Risco em 5 anos de 3% ou mais: pela KDIG: 5-year risk of 3% or more: per KDIGO 2024 (PP 2.2.1), we suggest considering referral to a nephrologist (the threshold is between 3% and 5%, together with the eGFR and uACR criteria).
textos.KFRE com a calibração para fora da Améri: KFRE with the calibration for outside North America; the equation was derived with eGFR by CKD-EPI 2009 and has no validation in a Brazilian cohort.

textos.Pesquisa de sangue oculto nas fezes por: Fecal immunochemical test (FIT) for occult blood, yearly, as an alternative to colonoscopy: we suggest choosing one of the two methods and removing the other. Positive: colonoscopy. It is the SUS screening test for asymptomatic people aged 50 to 75.
textos.A frequência de TFG e albuminúria depend: The frequency of eGFR and albuminuria depends on the G stage (eGFR) and the A category (albuminuria). With creatinine and the albumin/creatinine ratio entered, or with the item details checked, we adjust the frequency; without them, the minimum is once a year.
textos.Faltam PAS e PAD para classificar: SBP and DBP missing to classify
textos.A insulina é usada no diabetes tipo 1, n: Insulin is used in type 1, type 2, gestational and other types of diabetes, so it does not check a type on its own. The recommendations were built as for a person with diabetes. With the type checked, they become more precise (for example, TSH in type 1).
textos.Insulina: indica diabetes, mas não o tip: Insulin: indicates diabetes, but not the type (type 1, type 2, gestational and others use it). We suggest checking the type of diabetes.
textos.HbA1c ≥ 6,5% é critério de diabetes (con: HbA1c ≥ 6.5% is a criterion for diabetes (confirm with a second test if there is no unequivocal hyperglycemia), but it does not define the type. The recommendations were built as for a person with diabetes. With the type checked, they become more precise (for example, TSH in type 1).
textos.Primeira colonoscopia de vigilância 8 an: First surveillance colonoscopy 8 years after symptom onset (right at diagnosis if there is primary sclerosing cholangitis) when there is Crohn's with 1/3 or more of the colon; the next interval depends on risk. With the item's details ticked, we calculate the interval.

First surveillance colonoscopy 8 years after symptom onset (right at diagnosis if there is primary sclerosing cholangitis) when there is colitis beyond the rectum; the next interval depends on risk. With the item's details ticked, we calculate the interval.
textos.O item antigo reunia doenças com acompan: The old item grouped diseases with different follow-up. We suggest choosing the disease from the list (rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, spondyloarthritis, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis or systemic sclerosis).
textos.Para entrar na conferência, o nome do ex: To be included in the check, the test name must be chosen from the catalog list.
textos.Define a frequência de TFG, albuminúria: Defines the frequency of eGFR, albuminuria and the tests from G3a onward (KDIGO 2024). The stage is calculated from the creatinine and the albumin/creatinine ratio entered in "Tests already done".
textos.HbA1c ≥ 6,5% isolada não confirma diabet: An isolated HbA1c ≥ 6.5% does not confirm diabetes (ADA 2026): we suggest a second test (HbA1c or fasting glucose) and the box is not checked. With a confirmed diagnosis or unequivocal hyperglycemia, the type of diabetes can be checked.
textos.Define o passo seguinte: novo teste em 5: Defines the next step: new test in 5 years, in 1 year, or colposcopy.
textos.Colonoscopia e pesquisa de sangue oculto: Colonoscopy and the fecal immunochemical test (FIT) are alternatives for the same colorectal cancer screening (USPSTF 2021; USMSTF 2022): we suggest ordering only one of the two.
textos.Depois dos 65 anos não sugerimos o teste: After 65 years we do not suggest the HPV DNA test. The exception is inadequate prior screening ("No" answer on the form) or CIN 2, CIN 3 or adenocarcinoma in situ treated in the last 25 years: in these cases screening continues.
textos.Rastreio anterior inadequado. MS 2025 (r: Inadequate prior screening. Ministry of Health 2025 (rec. 13): a woman over 60 without a previous test has one HPV DNA test; negative, screening ends. ACOG 2026: after 65 years, continue until adequate screening is complete. The decision to screen is individual, based on health and life expectancy.
textos.Opcional. Escolha entre os exames mais c: Optional. Pick from the most common tests, add another one from the catalog or attach the lab report as a PDF; enter the date and, if you wish, the result. Anything still within the guideline interval is not ordered again. Cholesterol, HDL, creatinine, HbA1c, albumin/creatinine ratio and HPV DNA feed the calculations (PREVENT, eGFR by CKD-EPI, kidney risk and cervical screening); the other results appear in the summary. The report is read and discarded; nothing is stored.
textos.Confira nomes, datas e resultados antes: Check names, dates and results before generating.
textos.Com IMC de 30 kg/m² ou mais, sugerimos o: With a BMI of 30 kg/m² or higher, we suggest offering or referring to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions (diet, physical activity and behavioral support).
textos.Com fator de risco cardiovascular (disli: With a cardiovascular risk factor (dyslipidemia), we suggest offering or referring to behavioral counseling on healthy diet and physical activity.
textos.Com fator de risco cardiovascular (hiper: With a cardiovascular risk factor (hypertension), we suggest offering or referring to behavioral counseling on healthy diet and physical activity.
With cardiovascular risk factors (hypertension, dyslipidemia), we suggest offering or referring to behavioral counseling on healthy diet and physical activity.
textos.Com história familiar de câncer de mama,: With a family history of breast cancer, we suggest estimating risk with a validated tool. If risk is increased and the risk of adverse effects is low, discuss tamoxifen, raloxifene or an aromatase inhibitor. Without increased risk, routine use is not recommended.
textos.Gestação: aleitamento, ganho de peso e s: Pregnancy: breastfeeding, weight gain and mental health
textos.Para adultos com risco aumentado de infe: For adults at increased risk of sexually transmitted infection, we suggest behavioral counseling (condom use, risk reduction), in addition to periodic testing.
textos.Puerpério: apoio ao aleitamento e saúde: Postpartum: breastfeeding support and mental health
textos.Sugerimos aconselhar a parar e oferecer: We suggest advising to quit and offering behavioral interventions. Outside pregnancy, add approved pharmacotherapy (nicotine replacement, bupropion or varenicline).
We suggest advising to quit and offering behavioral interventions. In pregnancy, the recommendation is behavioral intervention; the evidence on pharmacotherapy is insufficient.
textos.Sugerimos apoiar o aleitamento materno d: We suggest supporting breastfeeding during pregnancy and after birth; counseling on healthy weight gain in pregnancy; and, with increased risk of perinatal depression (history of depression, current depressive symptoms, socioeconomic factors), providing or referring to counseling.
textos.Sugerimos apoiar o aleitamento materno e: We suggest supporting breastfeeding and, with increased risk of perinatal depression, providing or referring to counseling.
textos.Tabagismo: oferecer tratamento para para: Tobacco: offer treatment to quit smoking
textos.USPSTF A e B (aleitamento 2025 e depress: USPSTF A and B (breastfeeding 2025 and perinatal depression 2019)
textos.USPSTF A e B (aleitamento 2025 e ganho d: USPSTF A and B (breastfeeding 2025, weight gain 2021 and perinatal depression 2019)

textos.Suspeita ou valvopatia moderada a grave: Suspected or known moderate to severe valvular disease.

textos.Assintomático antes de cirurgia de alto: Asymptomatic before high-risk surgery: the SBC allows it (IIb); the AHA sees no benefit.
textos.A AHA indica em qualquer cirurgia; a SBC: The AHA recommends it before any surgery; the SBC restricts it to intermediate- or high-risk surgery.
textos.Estratifica o risco: BNP > 92 ng/L ou NT: Stratifies risk: BNP > 92 ng/L or NT-proBNP ≥ 300 ng/L indicate increased risk.
textos.A SBC indica (classe I) a partir de 65 a: The SBC recommends it (class I) from age 65, or from age 45 with a risk factor; the AHA only with cardiovascular disease, age 65 or older, or symptoms, in elevated-risk surgery.
textos.A AHA indica (2a); pelos critérios da SB: The AHA recommends it (2a); by SBC criteria it would not be indicated.
textos.Dosagem antes da cirurgia e com 24 e 48: Measure before surgery and at 24 and 48 h after, to detect myocardial injury.
textos.Indicada só pela SBC (risco intermediári: Recommended only by the SBC (intermediate or high risk by score in intermediate- or high-risk surgery).
textos.Indicada só pela AHA (2b); pela SBC o pa: Recommended only by the AHA (2b); by the SBC the patient is at low risk.
textos.Cirurgia de urgência: o resultado não mu: Urgent surgery: the result would not change management.
textos.Só se o resultado puder mudar a conduta: Only if the result could change management (revascularization or postponing surgery).
textos.Alternativa à cintilografia, com o mesmo: Alternative to scintigraphy, with the same criterion.
textos.Procura anatomia de alto risco (tronco ≥: Looks for high-risk anatomy (left main ≥ 50% or three-vessel disease ≥ 70%).
textos.Admitida pela AHA (2b); a SBC não a reco: Allowed by the AHA (2b); the SBC does not recommend it for risk stratification.
textos.Prova funcional ou angiotomografia de co: Stress testing or coronary CT angiography
textos.Risco baixo pelo escore ou boa capacidad: Low risk by score or good functional capacity: no benefit.
textos.Só com as mesmas indicações de fora da c: Only for the same indications as outside surgery (ACS, extensive ischemia).

textos.Cirurgia urológica: se uma infecção urin: Urologic surgery: if a urinary tract infection would change the decision to operate.
textos.Não é exame de rotina; só com sinais ou: Not a routine test; only with new cardiopulmonary signs or symptoms.
textos.Perguntar sobre gravidez; testar, com co: Ask about pregnancy; test, with consent, if in doubt.
textos.Condição grave ou instável: estabilizar: Severe or unstable condition: stabilize first; postpone elective surgery.
textos.Angioplastia com balão há menos de 14 di: Balloon angioplasty less than 14 days ago
textos.Esperar pelo menos 14 dias para a cirurg: Wait at least 14 days before elective surgery.
textos.A SBC não aborda angioplastia só com bal: The SBC does not address balloon-only angioplasty.
textos.Cirurgia eletiva que interrompa antiagre: Elective surgery that interrupts antiplatelet therapy is potentially harmful: postpone.
textos.O ideal é esperar 12 meses para cirurgia: Ideally wait 12 months for elective surgery that interrupts antiplatelet therapy. Between 6 and 12 months (SBC IIa) or from 30 days to 6 months (SBC IIb), only after multidisciplinary discussion and while continuing aspirin.
textos.A SBC gradua as faixas intermediárias; a: The SBC grades the intermediate ranges; the AHA only the 3-month one in time-sensitive surgery (2b).
textos.O ideal é esperar 6 meses para cirurgia: Ideally wait 6 months for elective surgery that interrupts antiplatelet therapy; in time-sensitive surgery, from 3 months if the delay is riskier.
textos.O intervalo mínimo para cirurgia eletiva: The minimum interval for elective surgery has passed. Continue aspirin.
textos.Sem a data não dá para saber se a cirurg: Without the date it is not possible to know whether elective surgery needs to wait (14 days after balloon angioplasty; 6 months after a drug-eluting stent for chronic disease; 12 months for ACS).
textos.AVC ou AIT há menos de 3 meses: Stroke or TIA less than 3 months ago
textos.Adiar a cirurgia eletiva para pelo menos: Postpone elective surgery until at least 3 months after the event.
textos.Hipertensão não controlada: adiar a ciru: Uncontrolled hypertension: postpone elective surgery and control the blood pressure.
textos.A SBC adia (I-C) em cirurgia de alto ris: The SBC postpones (I-C) in high-risk surgery; the AHA "may consider" it (2b) in elevated-risk surgery with an RCRI risk factor.
textos.Operar sem exames que atrasem a cirurgia: Operate without tests that would delay surgery; only monitoring and risk reduction.
textos.Cirurgia de emergência: sem avaliação qu: Emergency surgery: no evaluation that would delay the operation. Monitoring, postoperative troponin if at risk, and medication management.
textos.SCA, IC descompensada, angina CCS III/IV: ACS, decompensated HF, CCS class III/IV angina, symptomatic severe aortic or mitral stenosis, complete heart block/VT, AF with HR > 120, BP > 180 × 110, symptomatic PAH.
textos.Condição grave ou instável: estabilizar: Severe or unstable condition: stabilize and postpone elective surgery; cardiology evaluation indicated.
textos.Baixo risco (< 1%) em paciente estável:: Low risk (< 1%) in a stable patient: no cardiology evaluation or cardiac testing is indicated.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco em paciente está: Low-risk surgery in a stable patient: cardiology evaluation and cardiac testing not indicated. Surgery may proceed.
textos.RCRI 0–1 e AUB-HAS2 0–1 (risco < 1%): li: RCRI 0–1 and AUB-HAS2 0–1 (risk < 1%): clear without ischemia testing.
textos.Risco baixo pelos escores: liberar sem i: Low risk by scores: clear without ischemia workup.
textos.≥ 4 METs (sobe 2 lances) ou DASI > 34, s: ≥ 4 METs (climbs 2 flights) or DASI > 34, no symptoms: clear without stress testing. Low or unknown: biomarkers and, only if it would change management, stress testing.
textos.Risco elevado, mas boa capacidade funcio: Elevated risk, but good functional capacity and no symptoms: clear without stress testing.
First, see what calls for postponement.
textos.Com instrumento validado (CFS, FRAIL) em: With a validated tool (CFS, FRAIL) in patients aged 65 or older undergoing intermediate- or high-risk surgery.
textos.Parar 4 semanas ou mais antes reduz comp: Stopping 4 weeks or more before surgery reduces respiratory and wound-healing complications; stopping closer to surgery does not increase the risk.
textos.Fisioterapia respiratória, exercícios de: Chest physiotherapy, deep-breathing exercises or incentive spirometry.
textos.Para detectar injúria miocárdica após a: To detect myocardial injury after surgery.
textos.Manter PAM ≥ 60–65 mmHg ou PAS ≥ 90 mmHg: Keep MAP ≥ 60–65 mmHg or SBP ≥ 90 mmHg and treat postoperative hypotension.
textos.A AHA recomenda o escore em quem tem doe: The AHA recommends the score in patients with known cardiovascular disease (2a) and classifies risk as low or elevated (≥ 1%); the SBC calculates it for everyone, as low, intermediate or high. We chose to calculate it for everyone and show both classifications.

textos.Manter, inclusive no dia: Continue, including on the day of surgery
textos.Manter no perioperatório conforme a situ: Continue perioperatively according to the clinical situation; if the oral route is unavailable, consider an enteral tube or the IV route (SBC, Box 8, in HF).
textos.O diurético da associação acompanha a co: The diuretic in the combination follows the same management (SBC I-C, Box 10).
textos.Manter no perioperatório para reduzir ev: Continue perioperatively to reduce major adverse cardiovascular events.
textos.A ezetimiba da associação acompanha a co: The ezetimibe in the combination follows the same management.
textos.Na associação, o diurético acompanha a c: In the combination, the diuretic follows the same management.
textos.Na associação, o bloqueador de canal de: In the combination, the calcium channel blocker follows the same management.
textos.Na associação, o diurético e o bloqueado: In the combination, the diuretic and the calcium channel blocker follow the same management.
textos.ICFEr: manter no perioperatório e retoma: HFrEF: continue perioperatively and resume as early as possible; the 24-h omission suggested by the AHA applies only to use for hypertension.
textos.IC compensada: manter a terapia da IC no: Compensated HF: continue HF therapy perioperatively and resume as early as possible.
textos.AHA 2026: em selecionados (PA controlada: AHA 2026: in selected patients (controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery), omit the ACEI/ARB in the 24 h before surgery to limit intraoperative hypotension (2b, B-R).
textos.SBC 2024: manter no perioperatório, com: SBC 2024: continue perioperatively, with withholding allowed in selected cases (I-C).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a AHA neste perfi: We chose to follow the AHA in this profile, which fits the withholding in selected cases allowed by the SBC.
In this patient, both lead to continuing it.
textos.Omitir nas 24 h antes: Omit in the 24 h before surgery
textos.PA controlada e cirurgia de risco elevad: Controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery: omit the dose in the 24 h before surgery and resume as soon as clinically possible (AHA 1, C-EO; SBC I-C); in the SBC text, an ARB not restarted within 2 days was associated with higher mortality.
textos.Fora do perfil em que a AHA sugere omiti: Outside the profile in which the AHA suggests omitting it (controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery): continue, including on the day of surgery, and resume as soon as possible postoperatively.
textos.Cautela ao manter anti-hipertensivo em ≥: Use caution when continuing antihypertensives in patients ≥65 years, with low or borderline BP, or at high risk of hypotension (AHA note to §6.2).
textos.Falta informar se a cirurgia é de risco: Missing whether the surgery is elevated-risk: with controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery, the AHA suggests omitting it in the 24 h before; otherwise, continue.
textos.Falta informar se a PA está controlada:: Missing whether BP is controlled: with controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery, the AHA suggests omitting it in the 24 h before; otherwise, continue.
textos.Falta informar se a cirurgia é de risco: Missing whether the surgery is elevated-risk and whether BP is controlled: with controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery, the AHA suggests omitting it in the 24 h before; otherwise, continue.
textos.Se omitido, retomar assim que clinicamen: If omitted, resume as soon as clinically possible (AHA 1, C-EO; SBC I-C); in the SBC text, an ARB not restarted within 2 days was associated with higher mortality.
textos.Terapia da ICFEr: manter no perioperatór: HFrEF therapy: continue perioperatively (the ARNI contains an ARB and falls under the recommendation for RAAS inhibitors in HFrEF) and resume as early as possible.
textos.Manter; a suspensão é permitida em casos: Continue; withholding is allowed in selected cases (SBC). The AHA has no formal recommendation: the text considers continuation reasonable, watching for hypotension with dihydropyridines and bradycardia with diltiazem and verapamil.
textos.IC: manter, como as demais medicações de: HF: continue, like the other chronic medications, and resume as early as possible; optimize volume status, avoiding dehydration (SBC I-C, Box 9).
textos.Manter, com suspensão permitida em casos: Continue, with withholding allowed in selected cases (SBC); in hypertension, the AHA considers continuing reasonable and recommends resuming as soon as possible (1, C-EO). Optimize volume status, avoiding dehydration (SBC I-C).
textos.IC compensada: manter a terapia da IC (e: Compensated HF: continue HF therapy (except SGLT2 inhibitors) perioperatively and resume as early as possible.
textos.Manter: a suspensão abrupta pode causar: Continue: abrupt withdrawal can cause rebound hypertension (AHA text). Starting clonidine to reduce cardiovascular risk provides no benefit (AHA 3: No Benefit, B-R).
textos.Na hipertensão, é razoável manter a tera: In hypertension, it is reasonable to continue antihypertensive therapy perioperatively and to resume it as soon as possible postoperatively (AHA 1, C-EO).
textos.IC: manter todas as medicações de uso cr: HF: continue all chronic medications perioperatively and resume them as early as possible; if the oral route is unavailable, consider an enteral tube or the IV route.
textos.Suspender ≥3 dias antes (última dose no: Stop ≥3 days before (last dose on D-4) to reduce the risk of metabolic acidosis (euglycemic ketoacidosis), also in HF; resume once the patient is clinically stable and on a normal diet (AHA text).
textos.Suspender ≥4 dias antes (última dose no: Stop ≥4 days before (last dose on D-5) to reduce the risk of metabolic acidosis (euglycemic ketoacidosis), also in HF; resume once the patient is clinically stable and on a normal diet (AHA text).
textos.O comprimido combinado leva junto a metf: The combination tablet also carries metformin, which the AHA considers reasonable to continue (2a, C-LD): this is only possible with metformin alone during that interval.
textos.O iDPP-4 da associação fica suspenso jun: The DPP-4 inhibitor in the combination is stopped along with it.
textos.A SBC 2024 não tem recomendação específi: The SBC 2024 has no specific recommendation for SGLT2 inhibitors and, in HF, calls for continuing all chronic medications (Box 8, I-C). We chose to follow the AHA, the only one with a specific recommendation for SGLT2 inhibitors.
textos.É razoável manter a metformina no periop: It is reasonable to continue metformin perioperatively for glycemic control; recent data do not associate it with lactic acidosis (AHA text).
textos.A SPAQI (consenso, 2021) orienta manter: SPAQI (consensus, 2021) advises continuing until the day before and not taking it on the morning of surgery; the SBC does not address the topic. We chose to follow the AHA.
textos.Manter até a véspera e não tomar na manh: Continue until the day before and do not take it on the morning of surgery.
textos.Em jejum, a sulfonilureia expõe a hipogl: While fasting, the sulfonylurea carries a risk of hypoglycemia.
The metformin in the combination is held as well.
textos.A AHA considera razoável manter a metfor: The AHA considers continuing metformin reasonable (2a, C-LD); for the combination tablet, SPAQI advises not taking it on the morning of surgery. We chose to follow SPAQI for the combination.
textos.Suspender no dia da cirurgia: Hold on the day of surgery
textos.Orientação multissocietária 2024: manter: Multisociety guidance 2024: continue in most patients, by shared decision-making; hold if the risk of gastric retention is high (dose-escalation phase, high dose, gastrointestinal symptoms, gastroparesis, intestinal dysmotility, Parkinson disease; weekly formulations cause more gastrointestinal effects).
textos.Se suspender: última dose ≥1 semana ante: If held: last dose ≥1 week before.
textos.Se suspender: não aplicar no dia da ciru: If held: do not inject on the day of surgery.
textos.Com preocupação de esvaziamento gástrico: If gastric emptying is a concern, liquid diet in the 24 h before; bedside gastric ultrasound helps assess aspiration risk.
textos.A semaglutida oral é diária e segue o es: Oral semaglutide is taken daily and follows the daily schedule.
textos.Tirzepatida (agonista GIP/GLP-1): aplica: Tirzepatide (GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist): applied by extension.
textos.AHA 2026 (texto, sem classe, citando a A: AHA 2026 (text, no class, citing ASA 2023): hold the weekly formulation >1 week before, without distinguishing individual risk; the 2024 multisociety guidance continues it in most patients and holds it only at high risk. The SBC 2024 does not address the topic. We chose to follow the 2024 multisociety guidance, which is more recent and specific.

AHA 2026 (text, no class, citing ASA 2023): hold the daily formulation the day before, without distinguishing individual risk; the 2024 multisociety guidance continues it in most patients and holds it only at high risk. The SBC 2024 does not address the topic. We chose to follow the 2024 multisociety guidance, which is more recent and specific.
textos.Manter na maioria; se alto risco, suspen: Continue in most patients; if high risk, hold 1 week before
Continue in most patients; if high risk, hold on the day of surgery
textos.Manter, com 60–80% da dose na noite ante: Continue, with 60–80% of the dose the night before
textos.Manter a insulina basal antes e no dia d: Continue basal insulin before and on the day of surgery; giving 60–80% of the usual dose the night before may be reasonable, especially in type 2 diabetes or in patients prone to hypoglycemia.
textos.Manter; na manhã da cirurgia, aplicar 50: Continue; on the morning of surgery, give 50% of the usual dose and consider reducing the previous evening's dose by 25%.
textos.Suspender no dia da cirurgia (exceto cor: Hold on the day of surgery (except for correction)
textos.Dose habitual até a véspera; no dia da c: Usual dose until the day before; on the day of surgery, only to correct hyperglycemia.
textos.Ajustar a dose da caneta na noite anteri: Adjust the pen dose the night before
textos.Componente basal: manter a insulina basa: Basal component: continue basal insulin before and on the day of surgery; giving 60–80% of the usual dose the night before may be reasonable, especially in type 2 diabetes or in patients prone to hypoglycemia.
textos.Componente aGLP-1 (diário): a orientação: GLP-1 receptor agonist component (daily): the 2024 multisociety guidance continues it in most patients and, at high risk of gastric retention, holds it on the day of surgery.
textos.Na associação em dose fixa, reduzir a do: In the fixed-dose combination, reducing the dose reduces both components.
textos.Sangramento mínimo: manter (AHA, Tabela: Minimal bleeding risk: continue (AHA, Table 13). SBC: cataract, I-B; low-risk endoscopy and dermatology, IIa-C (schedule the procedure a few hours before the next dose).
textos.Urgência: avaliar efeito residual e reve: Urgent: assess residual effect and reversal
textos.Na urgência, a interrupção por tempo pod: In urgent surgery, time-based interruption may not be feasible: coagulation tests or drug levels identify a residual effect; if present and with relevant bleeding, reverse with idarucizumab (AHA, text of §7.6 and Table 15).

In urgent surgery, time-based interruption may not be feasible: coagulation tests or drug levels identify a residual effect; if present and with relevant bleeding, reverse with andexanet alfa or prothrombin complex concentrate (AHA, text of §7.6 and Table 15).
textos.Falta o risco de sangramento da cirurgia: The surgical bleeding risk (minimal, low/moderate or high) is needed to choose the interruption and restart schedule (AHA, Table 13; SBC, Box 26).
textos.SBC (texto, sem quadro): suspender 48–72: SBC (text, no box): stop 48–72 h before, the "most accepted" approach for edoxaban.
textos.SBC (texto, sem quadro): suspender 24 h: SBC (text, no box): stop 24 h before, the "most accepted" approach for edoxaban.
textos.ClCr <15 mL/min fica fora das faixas do: CrCl <15 mL/min falls outside the ranges of Box 26.
textos.O Quadro 26 não traz linha própria para: Box 26 has no specific row for CrCl 30–50; the normal kidney function row was applied.
textos.Neuroaxial: interrupção completa por ≥5: Neuraxial: complete interruption for ≥5 half-lives (≥3 days for anti-Xa agents; ≥4 days for dabigatran, 5–6 if CrCl <50) and next dose ≥6 h after epidural catheter removal (SBC I-B).
textos.Última dose ≥48 h antes; reiniciar 48 h: Last dose ≥48 h before; restart 48 h after
textos.Anti-Xa com ClCr <30 e sangramento alto:: Anti-Xa agent with CrCl <30 and high bleeding risk: the AHA leaves 3 days without a dose (last on D-4); the SBC requires "at least 48 h". We chose to follow the AHA, which is more conservative.
textos.A SBC não tem quadro para a edoxabana (s: The SBC has no box for edoxaban (text only, no class); the AHA groups it with apixaban and rivaroxaban. We chose to follow the AHA.
