textos.Sangramento mínimo: manter (AHA, Tabela: Minimal bleeding risk: continue (AHA, Table 13). SBC: cataract surgery with INR in the therapeutic range (I-B), dermatology with INR ≤3.5 (IIa-C), dentistry (IIa-B); vitrectomy and trabeculectomy are exceptions and require interruption (I-B).
textos.Urgência ou emergência: suspender, vitam: Urgent or emergency surgery: stop, give IV vitamin K and replace clotting factors with prothrombin complex concentrate or fresh frozen plasma, depending on availability.
textos.Suspender 5 dias antes; ponte conforme o: Stop 5 days before; bridging according to risk
textos.Falta o risco de sangramento da cirurgia: The surgical bleeding risk is missing: with minimal bleeding risk (minor cataract, dental or dermatologic procedures) warfarin is continued; otherwise, it is stopped 5 days before, with bridging only at high thromboembolic risk.
textos.Última dose no D-6 (5 dias sem dose) e o: Last dose on D-6 (5 days without a dose) and operate with INR <1.5 (SBC I-C); INR the day before and, if ≥1.5, oral vitamin K 1–2 mg and repeat measurement (SBC text).
textos.Falta a indicação da anticoagulação (FA,: The indication for anticoagulation (AF, VTE or mechanical prosthesis) is missing to classify thromboembolic risk and decide on bridging.
textos.Ponte com HBPM ou HNF em dose plena quan: Bridge with full-dose LMWH or UFH once INR falls below the therapeutic range (SBC: INR <2), usually from D-3 to D-1; last LMWH 24 h before and UFH 4–6 h before.
textos.Varfarina de volta no D+1 (≥24 h), na do: Warfarin restarted on D+1 (≥24 h), at the usual dose; heparin resumed on D+3 (SBC: 48–72 h if high bleeding risk), at full or prophylactic dose by team decision, until INR is back in range.
Warfarin restarted on D+1 (≥24 h), at the usual dose; heparin resumed on D+2 (SBC: 48–72 h if high bleeding risk), at full or prophylactic dose by team decision, until INR is back in range.
textos.Suspender 5 dias antes, com ponte de hep: Stop 5 days before, with heparin bridging
textos.Retomar 12–24 h após, na dose habitual,: Resume 12–24 h after, at the usual dose, once hemostasis is achieved; prophylactic heparin before and after if VTE prophylaxis is indicated (SBC IIa-C).
textos.Dose plena: última dose 24 h antes: Full dose: last dose 24 h before
textos.Em dose plena, última aplicação 24 h ant: At full dose, last injection 24 h before and restart ≥24 h after (48–72 h if high bleeding risk), once hemostasis is achieved: intervals the SBC defines for LMWH in bridging, extended here to continuous use. The reviewed sources do not define an interval for the prophylactic dose.
textos.Prevenção primária: suspender 7 dias ant: Primary prevention: stop 7 days before and do not restart postoperatively (SBC text, based on POISE-2).
textos.AHA 2026: sem recomendação formal; a int: AHA 2026: no formal recommendation; stopping primary-prevention aspirin does not require a multidisciplinary decision, and platelet function recovers in 4 days (Table 12). We chose to follow the SBC (7 days).
textos.ICP prévia: manter o AAS em dose baixa (: Prior PCI: continue low-dose aspirin (75–100 mg; SBC: 100 mg/day) throughout the perioperative period; if not tolerated, P2Y12 inhibitor monotherapy may be considered (AHA).
textos.Exceções da SBC: neurocirurgia e procedi: SBC exceptions: neurosurgery and procedures with prohibitive bleeding risk, in which it is stopped 7 days before.
textos.Prevenção secundária: manter 100 mg/dia: Secondary prevention: continue 100 mg/day throughout the perioperative period.
textos.AHA 2026: na DAC crônica sem ICP, manter: AHA 2026: in chronic CAD without PCI, continue aspirin only in selected patients, when cardiac risk outweighs bleeding risk (2b, B-R). SBC 2024: continue in all secondary prevention (I-A). We chose to follow the SBC.
textos.Falta a indicação do AAS: em prevenção p: The aspirin indication is missing: in primary prevention, the SBC stops it 7 days before (I-A); in secondary prevention, it continues it throughout the perioperative period (I-A).
textos.Stent há ≤30 dias e cirurgia tempo-sensí: Stent ≤30 days ago and time-sensitive surgery: continue DAPT, unless bleeding risk outweighs the risk of stent thrombosis; multidisciplinary decision.
textos.Não suspender: adiar a cirurgia eletiva: Do not stop: postpone elective surgery
textos.Stent há ≤30 dias: cirurgia eletiva que: Stent ≤30 days ago: elective surgery requiring antiplatelet interruption is potentially harmful; postpone and continue DAPT. See the note on timing of surgery after PCI.
textos.DES há <3 meses e cirurgia tempo-sensíve: DES <3 months ago and time-sensitive surgery: continue DAPT, unless bleeding risk outweighs the risk of stent thrombosis; multidisciplinary decision.
textos.indicação da ICP e meses desde a ICP: PCI indication and months since PCI
textos.tipo do stent, indicação da ICP e meses: stent type, PCI indication and months since PCI
textos.Urgência: sem janela para suspensão elet: Urgent: no window for elective interruption
textos.Na urgência não há tempo para a suspensã: In urgent surgery there is no time for planned interruption: multidisciplinary decision weighing bleeding and thrombosis; if DAPT is interrupted before the minimum duration, operate in a center with on-site interventional cardiology (SBC I-C).
textos.Sangramento mínimo: manter o clopidogrel: Minimal bleeding risk: continue clopidogrel monotherapy (SBC: low bleeding risk, IIb-C; cataract, IIa-B; dermatology, IIa-C).
textos.Manter se baixo risco; suspender 5 dias: Continue if low risk; stop 5 days before if moderate
textos.Clopidogrel em monoterapia: a SBC mantém: Clopidogrel monotherapy: the SBC continues it in low-bleeding-risk procedures (e.g., dermatologic) and stops it 5 days before at moderate or high risk; the AHA low/moderate category (<2%) covers both scenarios.
textos.Se interrompido, retomar no pós-operatór: If interrupted, resume postoperatively as soon as possible (SBC text).
textos.Manter a dose habitual, inclusive no dia: Continue the usual dose, including on the day of surgery
textos.Manter a dose diária habitual. Com uso ≥: Continue the usual daily dose. With use for ≥3–4 weeks at a dose above the equivalent of hydrocortisone 15–25 mg/day (≈ prednisone 4–6 mg/day) and no HPA axis testing, give stress-dose coverage, parenterally under general or regional anesthesia (ESE/Endocrine Society 2024, good clinical practice).
textos.ACR/AAHKS 2022 (artroplastia de quadril: ACR/AAHKS 2022 (hip or knee arthroplasty in RA, SpA or SLE): continue the usual daily dose, without supraphysiologic dosing (conditional, low-quality evidence). We chose to follow ESE/Endocrine Society 2024 outside that setting.
textos.Recomendação feita para artroplastia ele: Recommendation made for elective hip or knee arthroplasty in rheumatic disease; for other surgeries, the evidence is indirect.
textos.ACR/AAHKS 2022: condicional, evidência b: ACR/AAHKS 2022: conditional, low to very low quality evidence
textos.Suspender um ciclo: operar quando vencer: Skip one cycle: operate when the next dose would be due
textos.Omitir a dose prevista antes da cirurgia: Omit the dose due before surgery and operate at the end of the dosing interval (e.g., every 4 weeks → operate in week 5); resume after wound healing (~14 days): wound closed, sutures removed, no swelling, erythema or drainage, and no active infection.
textos.Última dose 3 dias antes (operar no 4º d: Last dose 3 days before (operate on day 4); resume after wound healing (~14 days): wound closed, sutures removed, no swelling, erythema or drainage, and no active infection.
textos.O intervalo considerou o risco de infecç: The interval considered infection risk, not VTE risk.
textos.LES grave: manter; LES não grave: suspen: Severe SLE: continue; non-severe SLE: hold 1 week before
textos.No LES grave, manter; no LES não grave,: In severe SLE, continue; in non-severe SLE, hold 1 week before and resume after wound healing (~14 days): wound closed, sutures removed, no swelling, erythema or drainage, and no active infection.
textos.Não cobre outras indicações (ex.: transp: Does not cover other indications (e.g., transplant).
textos.Procedimento menor: manter; maior: suspe: Minor procedure: continue; major: stop 72 h before
textos.Procedimento menor: manter, inclusive no: Minor procedure: continue, including on the day of surgery. Major procedure: stop 72 h before.
textos.Manter até a véspera; não tomar no dia d: Continue until the day before; do not take it on the day of surgery.
Continue, including on the day of surgery.
textos.Manter antes e no dia da cirurgia, pesan: Continue before and on the day of surgery, weighing the VTE risk.
textos.Se suspenso, considerar o risco de gesta: If stopped, consider the risk of pregnancy.
Continue before and on the day of surgery.
textos.Manter antes e no dia da cirurgia, consi: Continue before and on the day of surgery, considering the postoperative VTE risk.
textos.Manter antes e no dia da cirurgia na pre: Continue before and on the day of surgery for breast cancer prevention or treatment; for other indications, with a VTE risk factor, stop ≥7 days before.
textos.Manter sem ajuste de dose, inclusive no: Continue without dose adjustment, including on the day of surgery.
textos.A conduta com anticoagulantes e inibidor: Management of anticoagulants and P2Y12 inhibitors depends on bleeding risk (AHA, Table 13): minimal (~0% major bleeding at 30 days: minor cataract, dental or dermatologic procedures), low/moderate (<2%) or high (≥2%).
textos.Com ICP prévia e anticoagulante oral em: With prior PCI and oral anticoagulant monotherapy, substitute aspirin while the anticoagulant is held, when feasible, until it is resumed; afterward, aspirin may be stopped.
textos.A AHA trata a anestesia neuroaxial como: The AHA treats neuraxial anesthesia as a higher-bleeding-risk procedure: complete interruption of the anticoagulant (≥5 half-lives: ≥3 days for anti-Xa agents; ≥4 days for dabigatran, 5–6 if CrCl <50) and team decision. With an epidural catheter, the next DOAC dose only ≥6 h after removal (SBC I-B). The reviewed sources do not define neuraxial intervals for antiplatelet agents or LMWH.
textos.Com diabetes ou risco de diabetes, é raz: With diabetes or at risk of diabetes, it is reasonable to measure HbA1c if there is no result from the last 3 months (AHA 2a, B-NR). There is no validated threshold; postponing elective surgery with HbA1c >8% may be reasonable, but time-sensitive or emergency surgery should not wait for the target (AHA text).
textos.Falta a indicação da anticoagulação (FA,: The indication for anticoagulation (AF, VTE or mechanical prosthesis) is missing to classify thromboembolic risk.
textos.Ponte com heparina indicada no alto risc: Heparin bridging indicated at high risk (AHA 2a, C-LD; SBC IIa-C).
textos.Sem ponte: a ponte de rotina aumenta o s: No bridging: routine bridging increases bleeding without reducing events (AHA 3: Harm, C-LD; SBC IIa-C).
textos.se a valvopatia é reumática (FA com valv: whether the valvular disease is rheumatic (AF with rheumatic valvular disease is high risk)
textos.se o câncer tem alto risco de TEV (alto: whether the cancer carries a high VTE risk (high risk in Table 14)
textos.o modelo da prótese (bola-gaiola ou disc: the prosthesis model (caged-ball or tilting-disc valves are high risk)
textos.AVC/AIT há >3 meses com CHADS₂ <5 também: Stroke/TIA >3 months ago with CHADS₂ <5 may also be considered high risk (note to Table 11).
textos.Referências: AHA, ≥12 meses após DES por: References: AHA, ≥12 months after DES for ACS (1), ≥6 months for chronic CAD (2a), ≥3 months if time-sensitive (2b), never ≤30 days with antiplatelet interruption (3: Harm); SBC, Boxes 22–23.
textos.Decisão sobre antiplaquetários e momento: Decision on antiplatelet therapy and timing of surgery by a multidisciplinary team, together with the patient (AHA 1, B-NR).
textos.AHA: após angioplastia só com balão, adi: AHA: after balloon-only angioplasty, postpone elective surgery for at least 14 days (1, C-LD).
textos.AHA: angioplastia só com balão há ≥14 di: AHA: balloon-only angioplasty ≥14 days ago; elective surgery cleared by the interval (1, C-LD).
textos.SBC (Quadros 22–23): intervalos pela ind: SBC (Boxes 22–23): intervals by PCI indication, without addressing balloon-only angioplasty separately.
textos.AHA: stent há ≤30 dias; cirurgia eletiva: AHA: stent ≤30 days ago; elective surgery with antiplatelet interruption is potentially harmful (3: Harm, B-NR). If surgery is time-sensitive, continue DAPT, unless bleeding risk outweighs the risk of stent thrombosis (1, B-NR).
textos.SBC: <30 dias, III-B (Quadros 22–23). Ci: SBC: <30 days, III-B (Boxes 22–23). Low-bleeding-risk surgery may be performed on DAPT (IIa-C); if DAPT is interrupted before the minimum duration, operate in a center with on-site interventional cardiology (I-C). Bridging with tirofiban: IIb-B; bridging with LMWH: III-B (Box 21).
textos.AHA: stent convencional após ≥30 dias de: AHA: bare-metal stent after ≥30 days of uninterrupted DAPT; elective surgery may proceed.
textos.SBC (Quadro 23): intervalo de 30 dias a: SBC (Box 23): interval of 30 days to 6 months, IIb-B.
textos.SBC (Quadro 22): intervalo de 30 dias a: SBC (Box 22): interval of 30 days to 3 months, IIb-B.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco de sangramento p: Low-bleeding-risk surgery may be performed on DAPT (IIa-C, Box 21).
textos.AHA: cirurgia tempo-sensível <3 meses ap: AHA: time-sensitive surgery <3 months after DES: continue DAPT, unless bleeding risk outweighs the risk of stent thrombosis (1, B-NR). In selected patients at high thrombotic risk, bridging with an IV antiplatelet agent may be considered if surgery cannot wait (<6 months after DES; 2b, B-NR).
textos.SBC: cirurgia de baixo risco de sangrame: SBC: low-bleeding-risk surgery on DAPT if PCI was <3 months ago (IIa-C, Box 21).
textos.Ponte venosa: a AHA admite até 6 meses a: IV bridging: the AHA allows it up to 6 months after DES (2b, B-NR); the SBC reserves tirofiban for <1 month after PCI (IIb-B) and contraindicates LMWH bridging (III-B).
textos.AHA: cirurgia tempo-sensível ≥3 meses ap: AHA: time-sensitive surgery ≥3 months after DES may be considered if the risk of delay outweighs the risk of events (2b, B-NR).
textos.Ponte venosa: a AHA admite até 6 meses a: IV bridging: the AHA allows it up to 6 months after DES (2b, B-NR); the SBC reserves tirofiban for <1 month after PCI (IIb-B).
textos.AHA: DES por SCA; idealmente adiar a cir: AHA: DES for ACS; ideally postpone elective surgery until ≥12 months (1, B-NR).
textos.Entre 6 e 12 meses após DES por SCA, a S: Between 6 and 12 months after DES for ACS, the SBC accepts operating (IIa-B) and the AHA prefers to postpone until 12 months (1, B-NR). We chose to follow the AHA: postpone, if surgery can wait.
textos.AHA: DES por SCA há ≥12 meses; intervalo: AHA: DES for ACS ≥12 months ago; interval met (1, B-NR).
textos.AHA: DES por DAC crônica; é razoável adi: AHA: DES for chronic CAD; it is reasonable to postpone elective surgery until ≥6 months (2a, B-NR).
textos.Entre 3 e 6 meses após DES por DAC crôni: Between 3 and 6 months after DES for chronic CAD, the SBC accepts operating (IIa-B) and the AHA considers it reasonable to postpone until 6 months (2a, B-NR). We chose to follow the AHA: postpone, if surgery can wait.
textos.AHA: DES por DAC crônica há ≥6 meses; in: AHA: DES for chronic CAD ≥6 months ago; interval met (2a, B-NR).
textos.Força diferente para o mesmo intervalo d: Different strength for the same ≥6-month interval: SBC I-A × AHA 2a.
textos.Exames cardíacos adicionais não mudam a: Additional cardiac testing does not change management in this profile; surgery may proceed.
textos.ASA IV — ameaça constante à vida: ASA IV — severe systemic disease that is a constant threat to life
textos.Doença coronária (angina, IAM, prova fun: Coronary artery disease (angina, MI, positive stress test, nitrate use, Q waves)
textos.Sobe dois lances de escada sem parar?: Climbs two flights of stairs without stopping?
textos.DASI — marque o que o paciente consegue: DASI — check what the patient can do
textos.Hipertensão, idade acima de 50 anos e se: Hypertension, age over 50 and male sex are counted automatically. BMI over 35 is calculated when weight and height are available.
textos.Os dados do paciente foram alterados. Av: The patient data has changed. Assess the risk again.
textos.AHA/ACC 2026 e SBC 2024; quando divergem: AHA/ACC 2026 and SBC 2024; when they diverge, both are shown with a note.
textos.Os PDFs saem com os exames marcados acim: The PDFs include the tests checked above; laboratory and imaging in separate files, each imaging test on its own page.
textos.A AHA indica em qualquer cirurgia (class: The AHA recommends it before any surgery (class 1); the SBC, only before intermediate- or high-risk surgery.
textos.A SBC gradua as faixas intermediárias pe: The SBC grades the intermediate ranges by indication; the AHA assigns classes to the drug-eluting stent (12 months for ACS; 3 months in time-sensitive surgery, 2b).
textos.A SBC indica (I-B) na IC conhecida sem e: The SBC recommends it (I-B) in known HF without an echo in the last year; the AHA sees no benefit in the stable, asymptomatic patient. We chose to suggest it, flagging the difference.
textos.A SBC indica (classe I) a partir de 65 a: The SBC recommends it (class I) from age 65, or from age 45 with a risk factor; the AHA only with cardiovascular disease, age 65 or older, or symptoms.
textos.A SBC trata como condição grave (Tabela: The SBC treats it as a severe condition (Table 2) and postpones (I-C) high-risk surgery; the AHA "may consider" postponing (2b) elevated-risk surgery in patients with an RCRI risk factor.
textos.Adiar a cirurgia eletiva por pelo menos: Postpone elective surgery for at least 3 months to titrate the treatment doses.
textos.Angioplastia recente em cirurgia que não: Recent angioplasty and surgery that cannot wait
textos.Boa capacidade funcional e sintomas está: Good functional capacity and stable symptoms: no benefit.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco: biomarcadores n: Low-risk surgery: biomarkers do not change management.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco: razoável operar: Low-risk surgery: reasonable to operate if there is an echo from the last year, no symptoms and normal LVEF.
textos.Doença renal ou medicamento que depende: Kidney disease or a medication that depends on kidney function (dose adjustment and risk of acute kidney injury).
textos.Hipertensão não controlada (≥ 180 × 110): Uncontrolled hypertension (≥ 180 × 110): control the blood pressure and postpone elective surgery.
textos.Informe se foi só balão, stent convencio: Enter whether it was balloon only, bare-metal or drug-eluting stent: the waiting periods differ.
textos.Insuficiência cardíaca conhecida, sem ec: Known heart failure, no echocardiogram in the last year.
textos.Insuficiência cardíaca recente, tratamen: Recent heart failure, treatment not yet optimized
textos.Manter o AAS e, se o risco de sangrament: Continue aspirin and, if bleeding risk allows, the second antiplatelet agent; operate in a center with multidisciplinary support and on-site interventional cardiology.
textos.Na suspeita de regurgitação, a AHA indic: With suspected regurgitation, the AHA recommends it before any elective surgery; with suspected aortic stenosis, only before elevated-risk surgery. The SBC restricts it to intermediate- or high-risk surgery.
textos.O coagulograma não mede o efeito do anti: Coagulation tests do not measure the effect of direct oral anticoagulants: interruption is guided by time and kidney function.
textos.A data foi informada só com mês e ano; c: Only the month and year were entered; check the exact day for the short waiting periods.
textos.Em cirurgia tempo-sensível, a AHA admite: In time-sensitive surgery, the AHA allows operating from 3 months if the delay is riskier (2b).
textos.Sem a indicação da angioplastia, valeu o: Without the angioplasty indication, the longest waiting period (ACS) was applied.
The minimum interval (14 days) has passed.
textos.Procedimento endourológico com trauma de: Endourologic procedure with mucosal trauma: screen for and treat bacteriuria beforehand.
Low risk by score: no benefit.
textos.Se uma infecção urinária mudar a decisão: If a urinary tract infection would change the decision to operate.
textos.Sem a data não dá para saber se a cirurg: Without the date it is not possible to know whether elective surgery needs to wait (14 days after balloon angioplasty; 30 days after any stent; 6 months in chronic coronary disease; 12 months in ACS).
textos.Sopro: suspeita de valvopatia moderada o: Murmur: suspected moderate or severe valvular disease.
textos.Só a AHA admite (2b, \"pode ser razoável: Only the AHA allows it (2b, "may be reasonable"); by the SBC the patient is at low risk.
textos.Só com as mesmas indicações de fora da c: Only for the same indications as outside surgery (ACS, extensive ischemia on stress testing).
textos.Transplante hepático: ecocardiograma par: Liver transplant: echocardiogram for all patients (SBC Box 16).
textos.Valor basal antes da cirurgia, para comp: Baseline value before surgery, for comparison with postoperative measurements.
textos.Valvopatia moderada ou grave: ecocardiog: Moderate or severe valvular disease: echocardiogram within the last 6 months (SBC).
textos.CFS 9: expectativa de vida < 6 meses, se: CFS 9: life expectancy < 6 months, without evident frailty; it is not a frailty grade (CFS 2.0).
textos.Avisar a anestesia para as precauções pe: Notify the anesthesia team for perioperative precautions. Without decompensated systemic disease, there is no need to postpone surgery for polysomnography; patients already on CPAP should bring their device.
textos.Baixo risco (< 1%) em paciente estável:: Low risk (< 1%) in a stable patient: no cardiology evaluation or routine cardiac testing is indicated.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco em paciente está: Low-risk surgery in a stable patient: cardiology evaluation and routine cardiac testing not indicated. Surgery may proceed.
textos.Os sintomas ou sinais novos são investig: New symptoms or signs are investigated as they would be outside the surgical setting (see the tests).
textos.Exercícios de respiração profunda ou inc: Deep-breathing exercises or incentive spirometry. Later studies showed no benefit of incentive spirometry alone; inspiratory muscle training before major surgery reduced pneumonia.
textos.IAM ou parada cardíaca em 30 dias. Eleva: MI or cardiac arrest at 30 days. Elevated: ≥ 1% (AHA 2026). The ASA class is subjective and carries a lot of weight.
textos.O ARISCAT não foi derivado neste tipo de: ARISCAT was not derived for this type of procedure (local anesthesia only, outpatient or transplant).
textos.Procedimento sem categoria no NSQIP (oft: Procedure without an NSQIP category (ophthalmology, dentistry, endoscopy or transplant).
textos.RCRI 0–1, AUB-HAS2 0–1 e Gupta MICA < 1%: RCRI 0–1, AUB-HAS2 0–1 and Gupta MICA < 1%: low risk; clear without ischemia testing.
textos.Risco elevado, mas boa capacidade funcio: Elevated risk, but good functional capacity: clear without stress testing.
textos.SCA, IC descompensada, angina CCS III/IV: ACS, decompensated HF, CCS class III/IV angina, symptomatic severe aortic or mitral stenosis, complete heart block/VT, AF with HR > 120, BP ≥ 180 × 110, symptomatic PAH.
textos.Suspeita de apneia obstrutiva do sono mo: Suspected moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea
textos.≥ 4 METs (sobe 2 lances) ou DASI > 34, c: ≥ 4 METs (climbs 2 flights) or DASI > 34, with stable symptoms: clear without stress testing. Low or unknown: biomarkers and, only if it would change management, stress testing.
textos.Edoxabana com ClCr <30 e sangramento alt: Edoxaban with CrCl <30 and high bleeding risk: the AHA leaves 3 days without a dose (last on D-4); the SBC (text, no box) mentions 48–72 h. We chose to follow the AHA, which is more conservative.
textos.IC recente, tratamento ainda não otimiza: Recent HF, treatment not yet optimized
textos.ASRA 2018 (4ª ed.), anestesia regional e: ASRA 2018 (4th ed.), regional anesthesia and antithrombotic agents
textos.CDC US MEC 2024, critérios de elegibilid: CDC US MEC 2024, medical eligibility criteria for contraceptive use (MMWR 2024;73(4))
textos.Diretriz SBD 2025, Rastreamento e contro: SBD 2025 Guideline, Screening and control of perioperative hyperglycemia
textos.KDIGO 2022, diabetes na doença renal crô: KDIGO 2022, diabetes in chronic kidney disease
textos.SBA 2026, nota C.SBA-01744/2026 sobre aG: SBA 2026, note C.SBA-01744/2026 on perioperative GLP-1 receptor agonists and GLP-1/GIP co-agonists
textos.SBC 2024, Quadros 20 e 21 e texto do 4.1: SBC 2024, Boxes 20 and 21 and text of 4.1.3
textos.SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026, R2, R3, R16, R17 e n: SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026, R2, R3, R16, R17 and notes 2–3
textos.Na noite anterior, 70–80% da dose: The night before, 70–80% of the dose
textos.Na manhã da cirurgia, 50% da dose: On the morning of surgery, 50% of the dose
textos.Não tomar mais; dosar a cetonemia: Do not take any more; measure blood ketones
textos.Manter (evitar se IC ou risco de IC): Continue (avoid in HF or at risk of HF)
textos.Seguir a regra do aGLP-1 (curta ação): Follow the GLP-1 receptor agonist rule (short-acting)
textos.Tomar até a véspera; não tomar no dia: Take until the day before; not on the day of surgery
textos.Manter a DAPT, se o sangramento permitir: Continue DAPT, if bleeding risk allows
textos.Urgência: informar a hora da última dose: Urgent: report the time of the last dose
textos.RTU de próstata: suspender 7 dias antes;: TURP: stop 7 days before; TURBT: continue
textos.Suspender 1 dia antes; dieta líquida nas: Stop 1 day before; liquid diet in the 24 h before
textos.Suspender 7 dias antes; dieta líquida na: Stop 7 days before; liquid diet in the 24 h before
textos.Sem diagnóstico de diabetes, com 35 anos: No diagnosis of diabetes, age 35 or older: diabetes screening.
textos.Sem diagnóstico de diabetes, com fator d: No diagnosis of diabetes, with a risk factor: diabetes screening.
textos.A NICE NG45 não oferece HbA1c de rotina: NICE NG45 does not offer routine HbA1c testing to people without diabetes.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SBD/SBA/ABESO 2: We chose to follow the SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 (I-B) and the AHA (2a), which include people at risk of diabetes.
textos.Diabetes, sem HbA1c nos últimos 3 meses: Diabetes, no HbA1c in the last 3 months (target < 8% before elective surgery).
textos.Síndrome coronariana aguda de alto risco: High-risk acute coronary syndrome: invasive stratification, as outside surgery.
textos.Dispneia aos esforços: sintoma sugestivo: Exertional dyspnea: symptom suggestive of heart failure, no echo in the last year.
textos.A SBC indica (I-B) com sintoma sugestivo: The SBC recommends it (I-B) with a symptom suggestive of HF; the AHA only with new or worsening dyspnea.
textos.Risco baixo pelo escore, mas baixa capac: Low risk by score, but low functional capacity with known coronary disease: only if the result could change management.
textos.A SBC admite (IIb-B, Quadro 6); pela AHA: The SBC allows it (IIb-B, Box 6); by the AHA, risk < 1% clears the patient without testing.
textos.linha de base para o ECG do 1º e 2º dia: baseline for the ECG on postoperative days 1 and 2 (SBC Box 30)
textos.Dosar a HbA1c se não houver resultado do: Measure HbA1c if there is no result from the last 3 months (AHA 2a, B-NR).
textos.Meta antes da cirurgia eletiva: HbA1c <: Target before elective surgery: HbA1c < 8%, without hypoglycemia (SBD/SBA/ABESO I-B).
textos.HbA1c > 8%: encaminhar ao endocrinologis: HbA1c > 8%: refer to endocrinology and consider postponing elective surgery; HbA1c < 6% on insulin or a sulfonylurea: endocrinology referral, because of the risk of hypoglycemia.
textos.Cirurgia tempo-sensível ou de urgência n: Time-sensitive or urgent surgery does not wait for the target.
textos.No dia, glicemia > 250 mg/dL: considerar: On the day of surgery, glucose > 250 mg/dL: consider postponing; perioperative target of 100 to 180 mg/dL (I-A), with hourly glucose checks in intermediate or major surgery (I-A).
textos.Encaminhar ao endocrinologista para otim: Refer to endocrinology to optimize control and consider postponing elective surgery until HbA1c is below 8%, without hypoglycemia.
textos.No dia, glicemia acima de 250 mg/dL: con: On the day of surgery, glucose above 250 mg/dL: consider postponing.
textos.Cirurgia tempo-sensível: avaliação do en: Time-sensitive surgery: endocrinology evaluation beforehand, without waiting for the target.
textos.Condição grave ou instável: estabilizar: Severe or unstable condition: stabilize as much as time allows, without delaying urgent surgery.
textos.Condição grave ou instável em cirurgia d: Severe or unstable condition in urgent surgery: stabilize as much as time allows, without delaying the operation; cardiology evaluation and perioperative monitoring.
textos.Cirurgia de baixo risco, mas com dispnei: Low-risk surgery, but with new dyspnea, signs of heart failure or a murmur: assess ventricular or valve function (echocardiogram) before operating.
textos.AVC ou AIT recente com doença carotídea: Recent stroke or TIA with symptomatic carotid disease
textos.A revascularização carotídea é o tratame: Carotid revascularization is the treatment of the event: ideally perform it within the following 2 weeks, without waiting 3 months.
textos.Recomendação só da SBC (Quadro 30), por: Recommendation from the SBC only (Box 30), based on expert opinion.
textos.A AHA/ACC 2026 não recomenda UTI pelo ri: The AHA/ACC 2026 does not recommend ICU care based on score risk; it mentions intensive care only in specific situations (severe pulmonary hypertension, 2a; obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; mitral stenosis).
We chose to follow the SBC.
textos.Motivo: cirurgia de baixo risco (< 1%),: Reason: low-risk surgery (< 1%), in a patient younger than 65, with no comorbidity, no symptoms and no unstable condition.
textos.Com stent recente, decisão multiprofissi: With a recent stent, multidisciplinary decision.
textos.AHA: stent convencional após ≥30 dias; i: AHA: bare-metal stent after ≥30 days; interval met.
textos.AHA: stent convencional após ≥30 dias de: AHA: bare-metal stent after ≥30 days of DAPT; surgery may proceed.
AHA: bare-metal stent after ≥30 days of DAPT; the AHA defines no longer interval.
textos.Sem a indicação da ICP informada, valeu: Without the PCI indication, the longest interval (ACS) was applied.
textos.SBC 2022 (ICP): o mesmo prazo de 14 dias: SBC 2022 (PCI): the same 14-day interval after balloon angioplasty.
textos.SBC (Quadro 21, I-C): na cirurgia que nã: SBC (Box 21, I-C): in surgery that cannot wait, continue aspirin and, if bleeding risk allows, the P2Y12 inhibitor; operate in a center with multidisciplinary support and on-site interventional cardiology.
textos.Se a DAPT for interrompida antes do temp: If DAPT is interrupted before the minimum duration, operate in a center with on-site interventional cardiology.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SBC, como na te: We chose to follow the SBC, as in the postponement section.
textos.AHA: cirurgia tempo-sensível <3 meses ap: AHA: time-sensitive surgery <3 months after DES: continue DAPT, unless bleeding risk outweighs the risk of stent thrombosis (1, B-NR).
textos.Em selecionados de alto risco trombótico: In selected patients at high thrombotic risk, bridging with an IV antiplatelet agent may be considered if surgery cannot wait (<6 months after DES; 2b, B-NR).
textos.A AHA trata a anestesia neuroaxial como: The AHA treats neuraxial anesthesia as a higher-bleeding-risk procedure: complete interruption of the anticoagulant (≥5 half-lives: ≥3 days for anti-Xa agents; ≥4 days for dabigatran, 5–6 if CrCl <50) and team decision.
textos.Com cateter peridural, a próxima dose de: With an epidural catheter, the next DOAC dose only ≥6 h after removal (SBC I-B).
textos.ASRA: anti-Xa ≥72 h; dabigatrana 72–120: ASRA: anti-Xa agents ≥72 h; dabigatran 72–120 h depending on CrCl, and no block with CrCl <30; LMWH ≥24 h after a full dose and ≥12 h after a prophylactic dose; clopidogrel and ticagrelor 5–7 days, prasugrel 7–10 days; aspirin alone does not preclude the block.
textos.Procedimento de sangramento mínimo dentr: Minimal-bleeding procedure within the post-PCI interval: perform it on DAPT, without interruption (SBC: dentistry, IIa-B; cataract surgery with a recent stent, IIa-B; low bleeding risk < 3 months after PCI, IIa-C).
textos.tipo do stent, indicação da ICP e data d: stent type, PCI indication and PCI date
textos.Neurocirurgia: mesmo na prevenção secund: Neurosurgery: even in secondary prevention, stop aspirin 7 days before, because any bleeding can be catastrophic; resume as soon as hemostasis allows.
textos.Na ressecção transuretral de próstata, s: In transurethral resection of the prostate, without direct hemostasis, the SBC stops aspirin 7 days before, even in secondary prevention (some techniques allow continuing it: decide with the urologist).
textos.Rever a anticoagulação com o cardiologis: Review anticoagulation with the cardiologist before surgery; perioperative management then follows that of warfarin.
textos.Se a neuroaxial for indispensável, suspe: If neuraxial anesthesia is essential, stop it for longer (by the AHA, ≥6 days without a dose) and check for residual effect.
textos.Em dose plena, última aplicação 24 h ant: At full dose, last injection 24 h before and restart ≥24 h after (48–72 h if high bleeding risk), once hemostasis is achieved: intervals the SBC defines for LMWH in bridging, extended here to continuous use.
textos.Na anestesia neuroaxial (ASRA): punção ≥: For neuraxial anesthesia (ASRA): puncture ≥24 h after a full dose and ≥12 h after a prophylactic dose.
textos.Sem tempo para o intervalo de 24 h: info: No time for the 24-h interval: inform the anesthesia team of the time of the last injection.
textos.Anestesia neuroaxial só ≥24 h após dose: Neuraxial anesthesia only ≥24 h after a full dose and ≥12 h after a prophylactic dose (ASRA); with a recent dose, prefer another technique.
textos.Na IC sem FE reduzida com hipertensão, d: In HF without reduced EF and with hypertension, two AHA recommendations overlap: continue HF therapy (§6.3, 2a) and omit the ACEI/ARB in the 24 h before surgery in selected patients with controlled BP and elevated-risk surgery (§7.2, 2b).
textos.A SBC manda manter todas as medicações d: The SBC calls for continuing all HF medications (I-C).
We chose to continue it, because of the HF.
textos.Suspender ≥3 dias antes (última dose no: Stop ≥3 days before (last dose on D-4) to reduce the risk of euglycemic ketoacidosis, also in HF; resume once the patient is stable and on a normal diet.
textos.Suspender ≥4 dias antes (última dose no: Stop ≥4 days before (last dose on D-5) to reduce the risk of euglycemic ketoacidosis, also in HF; resume once the patient is stable and on a normal diet.
textos.Mal-estar, náusea ou dor abdominal no pe: Malaise, nausea or abdominal pain perioperatively: measure blood ketones even with normal glucose.
textos.A metformina da associação fica suspensa: The metformin in the combination is stopped along with it.
textos.Sem tempo para suspender antes: não toma: No time to stop it beforehand: do not take any more and, because of the risk of euglycemic ketoacidosis, measure capillary ketones (beta-hydroxybutyrate) and obtain a blood gas with anion gap; ketoacidosis can occur with normal glucose.
textos.Retomar só com dieta normal e paciente e: Resume only with a normal diet and a stable patient.
textos.SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 (R6, I-B): suspender: SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 (R6, I-B): stop 3–4 days before major surgery or a procedure with caloric restriction; otherwise, decide case by case.
textos.A SBC 2024 manda manter as medicações da: The SBC 2024 calls for continuing HF medications (Box 8, I-C), without mentioning SGLT2 inhibitors.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a AHA (3 dias ant: We chose to follow the AHA (3 days before any elective surgery), which is more protective against ketoacidosis.
textos.Manter até a véspera e não tomar no dia: Continue until the day before and do not take it on the day of surgery.
textos.Reintroduzir com o paciente estável, com: Restart once the patient is stable, with preserved kidney function and no complication causing tissue hypoxia.
textos.Suspender e rever o tratamento com o méd: Stop it and review treatment with the attending physician; postoperatively, do not restart without stable kidney function.
textos.AHA 2026: é razoável manter a metformina: AHA 2026: it is reasonable to continue metformin perioperatively (2a, C-LD), without mentioning the day of surgery.
textos.SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 (IIa-B) e SPAQI: mant: SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 (IIa-B) and SPAQI: continue until the day before and do not take it on the day of surgery.
We chose to follow the SBD/SBA/ABESO.
textos.Última dose pelo menos 24 h antes da cir: Last dose at least 24 h before surgery (in practice, do not take it the evening before or on the day): while fasting, the secretagogue causes hypoglycemia, which anesthesia masks.
textos.A SPAQI orienta só não tomar na manhã da: SPAQI only advises not taking it on the morning of surgery.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SBD/SBA/ABESO,: We chose to follow the SBD/SBA/ABESO, which is more protective against hypoglycemia.
textos.A SPAQI (consenso) orienta não tomar o i: SPAQI (consensus) advises not taking the DPP-4 inhibitor on the morning of surgery; the SBD/SBA/ABESO (R11, I-A, with randomized trials) continues it.
textos.O iDPP-4 pode ser mantido no perioperató: The DPP-4 inhibitor can be continued perioperatively (SBD/SBA/ABESO I-A), but the tablet contains metformin, which is not taken on the day of surgery (IIa-B).
textos.Os iDPP-4 são mantidos no perioperatório: DPP-4 inhibitors are continued perioperatively, but the SBD/SBA/ABESO avoids saxagliptin, especially with HF or HF risk (more HF hospitalizations in SAVOR-TIMI 53).
textos.Com IC: discutir a troca com o médico as: With HF: discuss switching with the attending physician.
textos.Manter no perioperatório: controle glicê: Continue perioperatively: glycemic control similar to basal-bolus insulin, with less hypoglycemia.
textos.A pioglitazona retém líquido e pode desc: Pioglitazone causes fluid retention and can decompensate HF, with an effect lasting days to weeks: with HF, discuss stopping it with the attending physician.
textos.Pode ser mantida em cirurgia eletiva não: May be continued for elective noncardiac surgery, with a stable patient and no long hospital stay expected; use caution with known or suspected HF.
textos.A SPAQI orienta não tomar na manhã da ci: SPAQI advises not taking it on the morning of surgery.
textos.Não tomar no dia da cirurgia (age só com: Do not take it on the day of surgery (it acts only with meals).
textos.Semaglutida, oral ou subcutânea (longa a: Semaglutide, oral or subcutaneous (long-acting): hold 7 days before.
textos.Tirzepatida, coagonista GIP/GLP-1 (longa: Tirzepatide, GIP/GLP-1 co-agonist (long-acting): hold 7 days before.
textos.Para todos: dieta líquida sem resíduos n: For all: clear liquid diet in the 24 h before and fasting for 8 to 12 h.
textos.Manter a dose só se estiver estável há m: Continue the dose only if stable for more than 12 weeks, without aspiration risk factors, and if the facility performs systematic gastric ultrasound (POCUS) on the day, at least 1 h before anesthesia; without POCUS, hold it.
textos.Fatores de risco de aspiração: início há: Aspiration risk factors: started less than 12 weeks ago or dose increased in the last 3 months; gastrointestinal symptoms; HbA1c > 8% or diabetes for more than 8 years; gastroparesis; prior gastrointestinal surgery, including bariatric; gastric residue on previous endoscopy; obstruction or achalasia; BMI ≥ 40; chronic opioid, tricyclic, anticholinergic or calcium channel blocker use; dysphagia or neurologic disease; moderate or deep sedation without a protected airway, prone position, sedation > 30 min or anticipated difficult airway.
textos.Com suspensão longa no DM2, o médico ass: With a long interruption in type 2 diabetes, the attending physician adjusts treatment to avoid hyperglycemia.
textos.AHA 2026 (texto, sem classe, citando a A: AHA 2026 (text, no class, citing ASA 2023): hold the weekly formulation more than 1 week before.
AHA 2026 (text, no class, citing ASA 2023): hold the daily formulation the day before.
textos.A orientação multissocietária de 2024 e: The 2024 multisociety guidance and the 2025 British consensus continue it in most patients.
textos.A SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 manteria quem está: The SBD/SBA/ABESO 2026 would continue it in patients stable for more than 12 weeks and without risk factors (R9, I-C); the May 2026 SBA note now requires systematic POCUS to continue it.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a nota da SBA de: We chose to follow the 2026 SBA note, the most recent Brazilian position.
textos.Reduzir a dose em 20–30% começando 72 h: Reduce the dose by 20–30% starting 72 h before (ultra-long-acting); up to 50% if basal insulin exceeds half of the total daily dose; with basal insulin up to half of the total dose and stable glucose, the reduction may be unnecessary.
textos.No DM1, LADA ou pancreatectomia total, n: In type 1 diabetes, LADA or after total pancreatectomy, never omit basal insulin (risk of ketoacidosis), unless on IV insulin or a working insulin pump.
textos.A SPAQI orienta 60–80% da dose na noite: SPAQI advises 60–80% of the dose the night before for basal insulins, with no specific timing for degludec.
textos.Reduzir a dose da noite anterior em 20–3: Reduce the previous night's dose by 20–30%; up to 50% if basal insulin exceeds half of the total daily dose; with basal insulin up to half of the total dose and stable glucose, the reduction may be unnecessary.
Continue basal insulin on the day of surgery.
textos.A SPAQI aceita 60–80% da dose na noite a: SPAQI accepts 60–80% of the dose the night before.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SBD/SBA/ABESO (: We chose to follow the SBD/SBA/ABESO (70–80%).
textos.Dose habitual na noite anterior; na manh: Usual dose the night before; on the morning of surgery, 50% of the dose (especially if NPH is more than half of the total insulin or if two-thirds or more is given in the morning).
textos.No esquema basal-bolus com NPH, reduzir: In a basal-bolus regimen with NPH, reduce each component by 50% and split NPH into three equal doses.
textos.A SPAQI sugere considerar também reduzir: SPAQI suggests also considering a 25% reduction of the previous night's dose.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SBD/SBA/ABESO (: We chose to follow the SBD/SBA/ABESO (no reduction the night before).
textos.Dose habitual até a véspera; em jejum, s: Usual dose until the day before; while fasting, stop the fixed mealtime doses and use only correction insulin (basal-plus regimen) until eating again.
textos.A associação em dose fixa segue o compon: The fixed-dose combination follows the GLP-1 receptor agonist component (lixisenatide and liraglutide are short-acting): hold it 1 day before, unless stable for more than 12 weeks, without risk factors and with systematic gastric POCUS at the facility; liquid diet in the 24 h before and fasting for 8 to 12 h.
textos.A insulina da caneta não reduz o efeito: The insulin in the pen does not offset the effect on gastric emptying; on the day without the pen, the attending physician defines basal insulin coverage.
textos.CDC US MEC 2024: cirurgia de grande port: CDC US MEC 2024: major surgery with prolonged immobilization is category 4 (unacceptable risk) for combined hormonal contraceptives; SPAQI continues them, weighing the VTE risk.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a SPAQI na cirurg: We chose to follow SPAQI for surgery without prolonged immobilization; when prolonged immobilization is expected, switch to a progestin-only or nonhormonal method in advance.
textos.Condição grave ou instável: estabilizar: Severe or unstable condition: stabilize as much as time allows, without delaying surgery.
textos.Condição instável: estabilizar primeiro;: Unstable condition: stabilize first; stress testing is contraindicated in high-risk ACS.
textos.Dispneia nova, sinais de insuficiência c: New dyspnea, signs of heart failure or a murmur: assess ventricular or valve function (echocardiogram) before operating.
textos.Indicada pela SBC no transplante renal (: Recommended by the SBC in kidney transplantation (Box 17, I-B), regardless of the score.
textos.andexanet alfa ou complexo protrombínico: andexanet alfa or prothrombin complex concentrate
textos.Ver o aviso sobre o momento da cirurgia: See the note on timing of surgery after PCI.
textos.Stent há ≤30 dias: cirurgia eletiva que: Stent ≤30 days ago: elective surgery requiring antiplatelet interruption is potentially harmful; postpone and continue DAPT.
textos.Neuroaxial: interrupção completa por ≥5: Neuraxial: complete interruption for ≥5 half-lives (≥3 days for anti-Xa agents; ≥4 days for dabigatran, 5–6 if CrCl <50).
textos.Em dose terapêutica, a primeira dose só: At a therapeutic dose, the first dose only ≥24 h after the puncture or catheter removal (ASRA 2025); the 6 h interval applies only to a prophylactic dose.
textos.Reinício após a punção ou a retirada do: Restart after the puncture or catheter removal: the SBC states ≥6 h (I-B), without distinguishing the dose; ASRA 2025 requires ≥24 h at a therapeutic dose and 6 h only at a prophylactic dose.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a ASRA, mais segu: We chose to follow ASRA, which is safer for patients on a therapeutic dose.
textos.A AHA trata a anestesia neuroaxial como: The AHA treats neuraxial anesthesia as a higher-bleeding-risk procedure: complete interruption of the anticoagulant (≥5 half-lives: ≥3 days for anti-Xa agents; ≥4 days for dabigatran, 5–6 if CrCl <50) and team decision. ASRA 2025, before the puncture, at a therapeutic dose: anti-Xa agents ≥72 h; dabigatran 72–120 h depending on CrCl, and no block with CrCl <30; LMWH ≥24 h after a full dose and ≥12 h after a prophylactic dose; clopidogrel and ticagrelor 5–7 days, prasugrel 7–10 days; aspirin alone does not prevent the block. After the puncture or catheter removal, a DOAC at a therapeutic dose only after ≥24 h (6 h only at a prophylactic dose).
textos.A SBC (I-B) fala em ≥6 h após a retirada: The SBC (I-B) states ≥6 h after catheter removal for a DOAC, without distinguishing the dose; ASRA 2025 requires ≥24 h at a therapeutic dose. We chose to follow ASRA.
textos.ASRA 2025 (5ª ed.), anestesia regional e: ASRA 2025 (5th ed.), regional anesthesia and antithrombotic therapy (Reg Anesth Pain Med)
textos.Bochecho com 15 mL de clorexidina 0,2% (: Rinse with 15 mL of 0.2% chlorhexidine (or 5% povidone-iodine) for 30 to 60 s before and after surgery to reduce infection; treat periodontal or dental disease before elective surgery.
textos.Cirurgia de emergência: operar sem exame: Emergency surgery: operate without tests that cause delay.
textos.Estabilizar e adiar a cirurgia eletiva;: Stabilize and postpone elective surgery; cardiac risk assessment indicated.
textos.Líquidos claros (água, chá, café sem lei: Clear liquids (water, tea, coffee without milk, pulp-free juice) up to 2 h before; a light meal up to 6 h before; fried or fatty foods or meat up to 8 h before. Adults may drink a clear carbohydrate drink up to 2 h before. Patients on GLP-1 RAs or tirzepatide follow their own guidance (liquid diet in the 24 h before and 8 to 12 h of fasting).
textos.Sem creatinina: confira a TFG, porque a: No creatinine: check the eGFR, because metformin is contraindicated below 30 mL/min/1.73 m².
textos.Manter até a véspera e não tomar no dia: Continue until the day before and do not take it on the day of surgery. Restart once the patient is stable, with preserved kidney function and no complication that causes tissue hypoxia.
textos.Mascar goma é uma \"alimentação simulada: Chewing gum is "sham feeding": it stimulates the vagus nerve and the cephalic reflex, which speed the return of bowel function and help prevent paralytic ileus. In 81 trials (9,072 patients), it brought first flatus about 10 h earlier and the first bowel movement about 13 h earlier, and shortened the hospital stay by about 0.7 day, with no more complications. Small, low-quality trials; the effect is smaller within enhanced recovery (ERAS) protocols.
textos.Pesquisar ferropenia: ferritina < 100 ng: Test for iron deficiency: ferritin < 100 ng/mL, transferrin saturation < 20% or microcytosis. If iron-deficient, iron before elective surgery reduces transfusion and raises hemoglobin; with less than 2 weeks to surgery, intravenous iron works better than oral iron.
textos.Reduz o sangramento, a transfusão e a an: Reduces bleeding, transfusion and postoperative anemia; decision of the surgical and anesthesia teams, weighing contraindications.
textos.Risco cardiológico indicado para este pa: Cardiac risk assessment indicated for this patient.
textos.Risco cardiológico não indicado para est: Cardiac risk assessment not indicated for this patient.
textos.Ácido tranexâmico se houver perda sanguí: Tranexamic acid if blood loss is expected
textos.Ficam fora dos pedidos; toque no + para: Left out of the orders; tap + to include.
textos.O risco cardiológico é indicado quando n: Cardiac risk assessment is indicated when none of these steps clears the patient; next to each, the answer for this patient.
textos.Os indicados já entram nos PDFs; toque n: Indicated tests are already in the PDFs; tap × to remove.

textos.· ClCr para as doses dos anticoagulantes: · CrCl for anticoagulant doses; eGFR for metformin
textos.A creatinina falta para fechar o escore: Creatinine is missing to complete the score and may change whether a cardiac risk assessment is indicated.
textos.A hemoglobina falta para fechar o AUB-HA: Hemoglobin is missing to complete the AUB-HAS2 and may change whether a cardiac risk assessment is indicated.
textos.Creatinina de exatamente 2,0 mg/dL: a AH: Creatinine of exactly 2.0 mg/dL: the AHA (Table 4) counts the point (≥ 2.0); the original Lee study and the SBC count it only above 2.0. We chose to follow the AHA, the more conservative option.
textos.Faltam dados para decidir o risco cardio: Data are missing to decide on the cardiac risk assessment.
textos.creatinina (com > 1,8 mg/dL, o VSG-CRI p: creatinine (at > 1.8 mg/dL, the VSG-CRI becomes 5 or more)
textos.creatinina (com ≥ 2,0 mg/dL, o RCRI pass: creatinine (at ≥ 2.0 mg/dL, the RCRI becomes 2, and at > 1.8 mg/dL, the VSG-CRI becomes 5 or more)
textos.Gupta MICA não calculado: falta a classe: Gupta MICA not calculated: the ASA class is missing.
textos.Gupta MICA não calculado: falta o estado: Gupta MICA not calculated: the functional status is missing.
textos.Gupta MICA não calculado: faltam a class: Gupta MICA not calculated: the ASA class and the functional status are missing.
textos.Risco do paciente incompleto, mas boa ca: Patient risk incomplete, but good functional capacity: clear without stress testing.
textos.O ClCr e a TFG supõem creatinina estável: CrCl and eGFR assume stable creatinine: they do not apply in acute kidney injury.
textos.Obesidade: o Cockcroft-Gault com peso re: Obesity: Cockcroft-Gault with actual body weight overestimates clearance; adjusted body weight is less biased. We chose actual body weight, the same used for Cockcroft-Gault in the anticoagulant trials (for example, ROCKET AF and EINSTEIN); with CrCl near a dose or interruption threshold, decide with caution.
textos.Rivaroxabana: ClCr dos estudos com peso: Rivaroxaban: trial CrCl with actual body weight (J&J Medical Information)
textos.Toque em um grupo para abrir e marque o: Tap a group to open it and check what applies. AF with heart rate above 120 bpm and BP from 180 × 110 mmHg are added automatically from the clinical data.
textos.Doença coronária (angina, prova funciona: Coronary artery disease (angina, positive stress test, nitrate use, Q wave)
textos.Diagnóstico recente, tratamento ainda nã: Recent diagnosis, treatment not yet optimized
textos.Sinais de insuficiência cardíaca ao exam: Signs of heart failure on examination (rales, S3, jugular venous distension)
Adjust if the clinical picture differs.
textos.Os exemplos da ASA sugerem pelo menos:: The ASA examples suggest at least:
textos.Mediana de 358 min na duodenopancreatect: Median of 358 min for pancreaticoduodenectomy and 213 min for distal pancreatectomy (NSQIP, 10,157 patients).
textos.Média de 93 min na artroplastia total de: Mean of 93 min for total hip arthroplasty (review of 630,675 procedures).
textos.Tempo-sensível: pode esperar até 3 meses: Time-sensitive: can wait up to 3 months. Urgent: 2 to 24 h. Emergency: less than 2 h.
textos.I saudável · II doença sistêmica leve ·: I healthy · II mild systemic disease · III severe systemic disease · IV constant threat to life · V moribund
textos.Sangramento maior em 30 dias: mínimo, ce: Major bleeding at 30 days: minimal, about 0%; low or moderate, less than 2%; high, 2% or more.
textos.Marque o que se aplica. Cada item abre s: Check what applies. Each item opens only the details that change management.
textos.IC descompensada, estenose importante si: Decompensated HF, symptomatic severe stenosis, rapid AF, symptomatic pulmonary hypertension and CCS III/IV angina open inside the item for the disease.
textos.DASI: o que o paciente consegue fazer: DASI: what the patient can do
textos.Hipertensão, idade acima de 50 anos, sex: Hypertension, age over 50, male sex and BMI above 35 are added automatically.
textos.Opcional. Creatinina, hemoglobina e HbA1: Optional. Creatinine, hemoglobin and HbA1c feed the scores; a recent ECG and echocardiogram are not ordered again.
textos.Média de 93 min na artroplastia total de: Mean of 93 min for total hip arthroplasty.
textos.Divergência: a Tabela 12 da SBC (varfari: Divergence: SBC Table 12 (warfarin) lists hip or knee replacement as low risk; we chose high, as in the SBC's own DOAC management.

textos.mediana de 53 min na hernioplastia ingui: median of 53 min in open inguinal hernia repair

textos.mediana de 130 min no reparo laparoscópi: median of 130 min in laparoscopic repair (147 min with mesh)
textos.130 min na esplenectomia laparoscópica (: 130 min in laparoscopic splenectomy (152 min in robotic)

textos.média de 185 min na lobectomia por vídeo: mean of 185 min in video-assisted lobectomy (178 min in open, 214 min in robotic)

textos.195 min na prostatectomia radical minima: 195 min in minimally invasive radical prostatectomy

textos.Artrodese lombar em série maior: média d: Lumbar fusion in a larger series: mean of 205 min, more than 3 h (Nooh 2017, NSQIP).
textos.Alto no câncer de mama; biópsia de mama: High in breast cancer surgery; breast biopsy or axillary lymph node dissection: low.
textos.Alto na cirurgia de cabeça e pescoço e e: High in head and neck surgery and in any operation longer than 45 min; thyroid biopsy: low.
